name: JoggAI
summary: AI video platform for avatar, product and image-to-video clips, with credits shared across the web app, API and MCP.
description: AI video platform for avatar, product and image-to-video clips, with credits shared across the web app, API and MCP.

pricing.details: Free 0 €, no credit card — 200 promotional credits valid 31 days (official FAQ: the Free plan does not renew credits monthly — this is a promo, not a recurring allowance), about 1 min of avatar video, maximum video duration 3 min, 1 custom avatar, standard processing, limited AI tools. Yearly (17% off; annual credits granted upfront, renews yearly): Starter 22 €/month — 144,000 credits/year (about 1,440 min of avatar video), 30 min max duration, 3 custom avatars, up to 50 voice clones/month, watermark removal, all AI tools; Creator 37 €/month — 264,000 credits/year; Team 195 €/month including 3 seats — 1,320,000 credits/year, 60 min max, 50 custom avatars, priority support. Official FAQ monthly: Starter starts at 26 €/month with 12,000 credits; unused monthly credits can roll over up to three months. Other monthly list prices besides Starter were not itemized in the FAQ and are left unlisted. Business Enterprise is contact sales.
